description: This file defines the GhostJetbrainsBridge class which integrates VSCode extension API with a GhostServiceManager to provide inline code completions in JetBrains IDEs, including argument parsing, content normalization, mock document creation, and command registration.

classes.name: GhostJetbrainsBridge
classes.description: Handles communication between VSCode extension API and GhostServiceManager for inline completions in JetBrains IDEs.

methods.name: determineLanguage
methods.description: Determines the language ID based on provided langId or file extension.

methods.name: parseAndValidateArgs
methods.description: Parses and validates RPC arguments using Zod schemas.

methods.name: normalizeContent
methods.description: Normalizes line endings in file content to LF.

methods.name: createMockDocument
methods.description: Creates a mock VSCode TextDocument with specified content and language.

methods.name: createMockContextProvider
methods.description: Creates a mock context provider to prevent workspace file access during inline completion generation.

methods.name: serializeCompletionResult
methods.description: Serializes inline completion items into a RPC response format.

methods.name: getInlineCompletions
methods.description: Main method to process arguments, generate inline completions, and handle errors.
